1_exact_treatment_identity.discrepancy_reported: The label POLARIS_STAGE8_1_EMS_V4G was recorded as metadata, but the executed optimizer configuration in execute_step10b_validation.py was standard unweighted LocalMILPEnergyOptimizer (gamma=1.0) without v4g_single_horizon_mode flags.

2_forecast_difference.detail: Stage81ForecastEngine in Step 10B treatment and LocalBaselineForecastEngine in Step 10C control evaluated identical fallback formulas (cs_ghi * 0.75) because no external stage81_sw_in_forecast array was supplied in runtime_context by H10RuntimeAdapter. Wind and demand were identically derived via LocalBaselineForecastEngine in both runs.

audit_findings.8_scientific_interpretation: Did this experiment demonstrate that the Stage8.1 forecasting model improved EMS optimization? NO. Because the H1.0 adapter path did not pass a precomputed Stage8.1 ML forecast array into runtime_context, Stage81ForecastEngine defaulted to the exact same diurnal clear-sky persistence fallback as LocalBaselineForecastEngine. As a result, both treatment and control received 100% identical forecast inputs and produced 100% identical dispatch decisions (195.500 L fuel). While closed-loop MPC execution, Same-Truth Firewall, and MILP solver correctness were successfully validated, this specific paired trajectory did not evaluate forecast sensitivity or demonstrate an operational fuel improvement from Stage8.1.
